items.title: Base editing rescues a hereditary motor neuron disease in mouse and patient-derived iPSC organoid models.
items.summary: In hereditary motor neuron diseases (MNDs), including forms of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) caused by single-nucleotide variants, effective therapeutic strategies need to address both gain- and loss-of-function mechanisms. Genome editing-based gene therapy represents a promising approach for simultaneously targeting these mechanisms. To establish proof-of-concept for base editing in a hereditary MND, we targeted the P285L variant in the TRK-fused gene (TFG), which causes hereditary motor and sensory neuropathy with proximal dominant involvement (HMSN-P), a disorder that shares clinical and histopathological features with ALS. We identified the optimal adenine base editor by comparing candidate editors in HMSN-P patient-derived induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs). We then generated a transgenic mouse model expressing human TFG P285L and evaluated the selected editor by subpial delivery of adeno-associated virus (AAV) vectors to the spinal cord. AAV-mediated base editing prolonged survival, preserved motor neurons, and attenuated axon loss in ventral nerve roots. Treatment with the selected base editing vector reduced TFG aggregation and suppressed neuronal death in HMSN-P iPSC-derived neuromuscular organoids. Collectively, these findings support the therapeutic potential of base editing for hereditary MNDs.
items.titleZh: 碱基编辑在小鼠和患者来源的iPSC类器官模型中挽救遗传性运动神经元病
items.summaryZh: 该研究在HMSN-P（一种与ALS相似的遗传性运动神经元病）模型中验证了碱基编辑疗法。研究人员在患者iPSC中筛选出最佳腺嘌呤碱基编辑器，并在表达人TFG P285L的转基因小鼠中通过AAV递送至脊髓，结果显示治疗可延长生存期、保护运动神经元并减少轴突损失。在患者iPSC来源的神经肌肉类器官中，编辑也减少了TFG聚集和神经元死亡。这些临床前结果支持碱基编辑用于遗传性MND的治疗开发。
items.insight: 这项研究为遗传性运动神经元病的碱基编辑治疗提供了重要的临床前概念验证，特别是针对与ALS共享病理特征的HMSN-P。其亮点在于：1）在患者iPSC中系统比较了不同碱基编辑器，为精准选择提供了依据；2）在转基因小鼠中通过AAV递送实现了在体编辑并观察到功能改善；3）在患者来源的类器官中验证了病理改善。这些结果支持将碱基编辑推向ALS相关单基因变异的治疗开发，并提示AAV递送和编辑效率优化是后续关键。

items.abstractZh: 在遗传性运动神经元病（MND）中，包括由单核苷酸变异引起的肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）类型，有效的治疗策略需要同时解决功能获得和功能丧失两种机制。基于基因组编辑的基因治疗代表了一种有前景的方法，可以同时靶向这些机制。为了在遗传性MND中建立碱基编辑的概念验证，我们靶向了TRK融合基因（TFG）中的P285L变异，该变异导致遗传性运动和感觉神经病伴近端显性受累（HMSN-P），这是一种与ALS具有临床和组织病理学特征的疾病。我们通过在HMSN-P患者来源的诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）中比较候选编辑子，确定了最佳的腺嘌呤碱基编辑器。然后，我们生成了表达人TFG P285L的转基因小鼠模型，并通过脊髓软膜下递送腺相关病毒（AAV）载体来评估所选编辑子。AAV介导的碱基编辑延长了生存期，保留了运动神经元，并减轻了腹侧神经根的轴突损失。用所选碱基编辑载体处理减少了HMSN-P iPSC来源的神经肌肉类器官中的TFG聚集并抑制了神经元死亡。总之，这些发现支持碱基编辑对遗传性MND的治疗潜力。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，首次在HMSN-P小鼠和患者iPSC类器官中证明碱基编辑可挽救运动神经元病表型，为ALS相关单基因变异的精准治疗提供了新近的临床前转化证据。

items.title: The thymus gland is a target and maintainer of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis pathophysiology.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease characterized by the selective loss of motor neurons in the brain and spinal cord with evidence of local neuroinflammation. Regulatory T cells (Treg) exert neuroprotective effects and correlate with disease progression, but central mechanisms governing Treg development during ALS remain unclear. We investigated the thymic architecture and T cell differentiation in SOD1-G93A (mSOD1) ALS mice at multiple disease stages. Thymocyte and thymic epithelial cells (TEC) subpopulations, as well as stages of Treg differentiation and suppressive capacity, were analyzed by flow cytometry, in situ immunofluorescence, and functional assays. At late disease stage (120 days-old), mSOD1 mice displayed thymic atrophy, reduced thymocyte numbers, and decreased double-positive (DP), CD4 single-positive (SP), and Treg populations. Foxp3 expression per cell was preserved, but Treg progenitors and mature Treg numbers declined, paralleled by reduced suppressive function in vitro . TEC analysis revealed reduced total and mature medullary TEC (CD80 high MHCII high ), despite preserved Aire expression. Foxp3 + cells were abnormally localized at cortical sites, away from mTEC, associated with migratory abnormalities and increased apoptosis. TREC evaluation revealed reduced intrathymic sjTREC, consistent with impaired proliferation and differentiation between DN and DP stages, although peripheral sj/βTREC ratios remained stable. Reduced Treg numbers were also observed in lymph nodes draining affected hindlimbs. Our findings identify the thymus as a target organ in ALS, where thymic involution, TEC loss, and Treg dysfunction may compromise immune tolerance. These alterations likely reinforce the role of the thymus in peripheral immune dysregulation and neuroinflammation observed in ALS.
items.titleZh: 胸腺是肌萎缩侧索硬化病理生理学的靶标和维持者
items.summaryZh: 该研究在SOD1-G93A ALS小鼠模型中发现，疾病晚期胸腺出现萎缩、胸腺上皮细胞丢失和Treg发育及功能受损，提示胸腺可能是ALS免疫失调的重要源头。
items.insight: 这项研究将ALS的免疫机制从外周Treg功能异常上溯至胸腺中枢耐受缺陷，为理解神经炎症的起源提供了新视角。若胸腺退化是Treg耗竭的上游驱动因素，则胸腺保护或中枢免疫重建可能成为ALS治疗的新切入点，值得关注其后续在人类ALS胸腺样本中的验证及与疾病进展标志物的关联。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，其特征是脑和脊髓中运动神经元的选择性丢失，并伴有局部神经炎症的证据。调节性T细胞（Treg）发挥神经保护作用并与疾病进展相关，但ALS中调控Treg发育的中枢机制仍不清楚。我们在多个疾病阶段研究了SOD1-G93A（mSOD1）ALS小鼠的胸腺结构和T细胞分化。通过流式细胞术、原位免疫荧光和功能实验分析了胸腺细胞和胸腺上皮细胞（TEC）亚群，以及Treg分化的各个阶段和抑制能力。在疾病晚期（120日龄），mSOD1小鼠表现出胸腺萎缩、胸腺细胞数量减少，以及双阳性（DP）、CD4单阳性（SP）和Treg群体减少。每个细胞的Foxp3表达得以保留，但Treg祖细胞和成熟Treg数量下降，同时体外抑制功能降低。TEC分析显示总TEC和成熟髓质TEC（CD80高MHCII高）减少，尽管Aire表达得以保留。Foxp3+细胞异常定位于皮质区域，远离mTEC，与迁移异常和凋亡增加相关。TREC评估显示胸腺内sjTREC减少，与DN和DP阶段之间的增殖和分化受损一致，尽管外周sj/βTREC比值保持稳定。在引流受累后肢的淋巴结中也观察到Treg数量减少。我们的发现确定胸腺是ALS的靶器官，其中胸腺退化、TEC丢失和Treg功能障碍可能损害免疫耐受。这些改变可能强化了胸腺在ALS中观察到的外周免疫失调和神经炎症中的作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了胸腺作为ALS免疫失调的中枢靶器官，将Treg功能障碍的机制从外周推进至中枢耐受层面，具有明确的转化潜力。

items.title: Repairing the Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Trial Credibility Gap.
items.summary: There is a long history of early- and mid-phase amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) clinical trial data being used to make claims of clinical benefit that fail to translate into successful phase 3 outcomes. It is suggested that fallacious scientific reasoning is being encouraged by perverse incentives arising from a "clinical trial industrial complex" that greatly influences trial design, data interpretation, and results communication. Recurring fallacies include false premises underlying outcome comparisons, misuse and incorrect interpretation of biomarkers, mismatches between study design and stated objectives, selective reporting of outcomes, over-reliance on post hoc analyses and open-label extension data, and overly optimistic framing of inconclusive data. We argue that these practices, reinforced by misaligned incentives across industry and academia, lead to premature claims of therapeutic promise and tangible harm to patients. To address the resulting ALS clinical trial credibility gap, we call for rigorous adherence to established standards for reporting clinical trial results, clearer distinction between hypothesis generation and hypothesis testing, more measured description of trial results, and more disciplined triage of phase 2 programs. A cultural shift toward scientific skepticism and methodological rigor is essential to accelerate the development of genuinely effective ALS therapies.

items.titleZh: 弥合肌萎缩侧索硬化症临床试验的可信度差距
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇发表于《Neurology》的观点文章，而非一项新试验。作者指出，ALS早期和中期试验常被用来宣称临床获益，但这些结果屡屡无法在3期试验中重现，形成了“临床试验可信度差距”。文章将原因归咎于产业界与学术界激励错位所构成的“临床试验工业复合体”，并列举了常见谬误：结局比较前提错误、生物标志物误用、设计与目标不匹配、选择性报告、过度依赖事后分析和开放标签扩展数据、对无定论数据过度乐观。作者呼吁严格遵循报告标准、区分假设生成与假设检验、审慎描述结果、严格分流2期项目，并推动科学怀疑精神和方法学严谨性的文化转变。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，这篇文章的价值不在于提供新机制或新疗法，而在于系统梳理了导致ALS试验反复失败的认知与方法学陷阱。它提醒研究者在设计2期试验、解读生物标志物（如NfL）变化、使用开放标签扩展数据时保持警惕，并强调2期阳性结果不应被等同于临床获益。对于关注试验终点选择、生物标志物验证和3期转化失败原因的研究者，这是一份值得纳入方法学讨论的批判性框架。

items.abstractZh: 长期以来，肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）早期和中期临床试验数据被用来宣称临床获益，但这些宣称未能转化为成功的3期试验结果。文章指出，一个极大影响试验设计、数据解读和结果传播的“临床试验工业复合体”所产生的扭曲激励，正在助长错误的科学推理。反复出现的谬误包括：结局比较所依据的错误前提、生物标志物的误用和错误解读、研究设计与所述目标不匹配、结局的选择性报告、过度依赖事后分析和开放标签扩展数据，以及对无定论数据的过度乐观表述。我们认为，这些做法在产业界和学术界激励错位的强化下，导致对治疗前景的过早宣称，并对患者造成实际伤害。为弥合由此产生的ALS临床试验可信度差距，我们呼吁严格遵循既有的临床试验结果报告标准，更清晰地区分假设生成与假设检验，更审慎地描述试验结果，并对2期项目进行更有纪律的分流。向科学怀疑精神和方法学严谨性的文化转变，对于加速开发真正有效的ALS疗法至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该文于2026年发表，直面ALS临床试验长期存在的转化可信度危机，对当前以生物标志物和2期数据驱动研发的转化路径提出了及时且具有约束力的方法学警示。

items.title: Herbal nanoparticles in the treatment of neurodegeneration: from molecular mechanisms to therapeutic translation.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases (NDDs), including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, are characterized by progressive neuronal loss involving multiple pathological mechanisms, including protein aggregation, oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, and mitochondrial dysfunction. Although conventional therapies provide symptomatic relief, they fail to halt disease progression and are limited by poor blood-brain barrier (BBB) penetration, off-target effects, and systemic toxicity. Likewise, several herbal bioactives, such as curcumin, resveratrol, quercetin, and epigallocatechin gallate, exhibit promising neuroprotective properties but suffer from poor aqueous solubility, low oral bioavailability, rapid metabolism, and inadequate brain delivery. Nanotechnology-based delivery systems have emerged as a promising approach to overcome these pharmacokinetic limitations by enhancing stability, controlled release, BBB transport, and brain accumulation of herbal therapeutics. This review critically summarizes recent advances in herbal nanoformulations, emphasizing disease-specific molecular targets, BBB-targeting strategies, comparative nanocarrier systems, pharmacokinetic optimization, intracellular trafficking, and translational challenges. Unlike previous reviews, it integrates recent evidence on nanotoxicology, manufacturing scalability, quality control, regulatory considerations, and emerging technologies, including biomimetic nanoparticles and extracellular vesicles. Despite encouraging preclinical outcomes, clinical evidence remains limited, and no herbal nanoformulation has yet demonstrated definitive efficacy or received regulatory approval for neurodegenerative diseases. Future clinical translation will require standardized formulations, rigorous safety evaluation, and well-designed clinical trials. Unlike previous reviews that primarily summarize individual nanocarrier systems or herbal therapeutics, the present review provides a comprehensive and critical synthesis of the current evidence by integrating disease-specific molecular mechanisms, herbal bioactives, nanocarrier design strategies, blood-brain barrier transport mechanisms, intracellular trafficking, pharmacokinetic considerations, translational barriers, regulatory challenges, clinical evidence, and emerging technologies. Furthermore, the review identifies major knowledge gaps and future research priorities to facilitate the successful clinical translation of herbal nanoformulations for neurodegenerative disorders. The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s13205-026-05048-8.
items.titleZh: 草药纳米颗粒在神经退行性疾病治疗中的应用：从分子机制到治疗转化
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了草药纳米制剂用于阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化等神经退行性疾病的分子机制、纳米载体设计、血脑屏障转运策略及转化障碍。文章指出，姜黄素、白藜芦醇、槲皮素等草药活性成分虽有神经保护潜力，但受限于溶解性差、生物利用度低和脑内递送不足；纳米递送系统有望改善这些缺陷。不过，目前临床证据仍有限，尚无草药纳米制剂在神经退行性疾病中证实明确疗效或获批上市。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，这篇综述的价值在于把草药纳米制剂这一相对边缘的方向放回神经退行性疾病的共同病理框架中审视：蛋白聚集、氧化应激、神经炎症和线粒体功能障碍都是ALS的核心机制。文章强调的BBB靶向、细胞内转运、药代动力学优化和监管瓶颈，同样适用于ALS药物递送开发。更重要的是，它明确指出现有临床证据不足，提醒研究者不要将临床前纳米制剂结果直接等同于ALS治疗突破。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病（NDDs），包括阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化，其特征是进行性神经元丢失，涉及多种病理机制，包括蛋白质聚集、氧化应激、神经炎症和线粒体功能障碍。尽管传统疗法可提供症状缓解，但无法阻止疾病进展，并受限于血脑屏障（BBB）穿透性差、脱靶效应和全身毒性。同样，几种草药生物活性成分，如姜黄素、白藜芦醇、槲皮素和表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯，表现出有前景的神经保护特性，但存在水溶性差、口服生物利用度低、代谢迅速和脑内递送不足的问题。基于纳米技术的递送系统已成为克服这些药代动力学限制的有前景方法，通过增强草药治疗剂的稳定性、控释、BBB转运和脑内蓄积。本综述批判性地总结了草药纳米制剂的最新进展，强调疾病特异性分子靶点、BBB靶向策略、比较纳米载体系统、药代动力学优化、细胞内转运和转化挑战。与以往综述不同，它整合了关于纳米毒理学、制造可扩展性、质量控制、监管考虑以及新兴技术（包括仿生纳米颗粒和细胞外囊泡）的最新证据。尽管临床前结果令人鼓舞，但临床证据仍然有限，尚无草药纳米制剂在神经退行性疾病中显示出明确疗效或获得监管批准。未来的临床转化需要标准化制剂、严格的安全性评估和精心设计的临床试验。与主要总结单个纳米载体系统或草药治疗剂的以往综述不同，本综述通过整合疾病特异性分子机制、草药生物活性成分、纳米载体设计策略、血脑屏障转运机制、细胞内转运、药代动力学考虑、转化障碍、监管挑战、临床证据和新兴技术，提供了当前证据的全面而批判性的综合。此外，本综述确定了主要知识空白和未来研究重点，以促进草药纳米制剂用于神经退行性疾病的成功临床转化。在线版本包含补充材料，可在 https://doi.org/10.1007/s13205-026-05048-8 获取。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了仿生纳米颗粒、细胞外囊泡等新兴递送技术，并直接讨论其在包括ALS在内的神经退行性疾病中的转化障碍，对关注脑内递送和神经保护策略的ALS研究者具有参考价值。

items.title: ATXN2 Spectrum Disorders: Genetic Complexity Beyond Dominant Inheritance.
items.summary: The genetic complexity of ATXN2 challenges conventional paradigms in neurodegeneration. While initially linked to autosomal dominant spinocerebellar ataxia type 2, ATXN2 CAG expansions have emerged as a major risk factor for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In a recent article, Saucier et al. describe an Acadian family with a recessive inheritance pattern of ATXN2 -related disease, challenging the long-held assumption of a predominantly autosomal dominant, gain-of-function-driven mechanism. Here, we analyze how ATXN2 's inheritance mode may shift based on repeat interruptions, somatic mosaicism, and gene dosage, suggesting that loss-of-function mechanisms contribute to pathogenesis in certain contexts. We discuss implications for disease classification, genetic counseling, and therapeutic strategies, emphasizing the need for genetic stratification.

items.titleZh: ATXN2 谱系疾病：超越显性遗传的遗传复杂性
items.summaryZh: 该文指出 ATXN2 的遗传模式比传统认为的常染色体显性遗传更为复杂。除脊髓小脑共济失调 2 型外，ATXN2 的 CAG 扩增也是 ALS 的重要风险因素。新报道的阿卡迪亚家族呈现隐性遗传模式，提示重复序列中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量可能影响遗传模式，且功能丧失机制在某些情境下可能参与致病。文章强调遗传分层对疾病分类、遗传咨询和治疗策略的重要性。
items.insight: ATXN2 是 ALS 领域少数具有明确遗传证据且与 CAG 重复扩增相关的风险基因之一。该文提示 ATXN2 相关疾病并非单一显性机制，隐性遗传、重复序列中断和体细胞嵌合可能改变表型与遗传咨询结论。对 ALS 研究者而言，这意味着在基因检测和患者分层中不能仅依赖显性遗传假设，未来针对 ATXN2 的治疗策略可能需要根据遗传机制亚型进行区分。

items.abstractZh: ATXN2 的遗传复杂性挑战了神经退行性疾病的传统范式。虽然最初与常染色体显性脊髓小脑共济失调 2 型相关，但 ATXN2 的 CAG 扩增已成为肌萎缩侧索硬化的重要风险因素。在最近的一篇文章中，Saucier 等人描述了一个具有 ATXN2 相关疾病隐性遗传模式的阿卡迪亚家族，挑战了长期以来关于主要为常染色体显性、功能获得驱动机制的假设。在此，我们分析了 ATXN2 的遗传模式如何可能随重复序列中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量而改变，提示功能丧失机制在某些情况下参与发病机制。我们讨论了这对疾病分类、遗传咨询和治疗策略的意义，强调需要进行遗传分层。

items.title: Causal relationship between metabolites, cerebral volume, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: A 2-step Mendelian randomization analysis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by motor neuron degeneration. Although metabolic abnormalities have been implicated in ALS, the causal relationships between circulating metabolites and ALS remain unclear. This study aimed to investigate the potential causal associations between plasma metabolites and ALS risk and to explore the mediating role of cerebral volume. A 2-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) study was conducted using publicly available genome-wide association study summary statistics. Genetic instruments for plasma metabolites were obtained from metabolomic GWAS datasets, and ALS-associated genetic data were used as the outcome. The inverse-variance weighted method was used as the primary analysis, with sensitivity analyses performed using MR-Egger regression, weighted median analysis, MR-PRESSO, heterogeneity testing, and leave-one-out analysis. A 2-step MR analysis was further conducted to evaluate whether cerebral volume mediated the associations between metabolites and ALS. Six metabolites showed significant associations with ALS risk. Genetically predicted higher levels of N,N-dimethylalanine, Behenylcarnitine (C22), and deoxycarnitine were associated with increased ALS risk, whereas higher levels of (N(1) + N(8))-acetylspermidine, Betaine, and tetradecadienedioate (C14:2-DC) were associated with decreased ALS risk. Sensitivity analyses supported the robustness of the findings. Two-step MR analysis suggested that cerebral volume did not significantly mediate the associations between these metabolites and ALS risk. This study identified 6 circulating metabolites genetically associated with ALS risk. These findings provide insights into the potential metabolic pathways involved in ALS and suggest that the observed associations are unlikely to be mediated through cerebral volume changes.

items.titleZh: 代谢物、脑容量与肌萎缩侧索硬化之间的因果关系：一项两步孟德尔随机化分析
items.summaryZh: 这项孟德尔随机化研究分析了血浆代谢物与ALS风险的因果关系，发现6种代谢物与ALS风险显著相关：N,N-二甲基丙氨酸、山嵛酰肉碱（C22）和脱氧肉碱水平升高与风险增加相关；(N(1) + N(8))-乙酰精胺、甜菜碱和十四碳二烯二酸（C14:2-DC）水平升高与风险降低相关。两步分析未发现脑容量在其中起显著中介作用。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种以运动神经元变性为特征的进行性神经退行性疾病。尽管代谢异常被认为与ALS有关，但循环代谢物与ALS之间的因果关系仍不明确。本研究旨在探讨血浆代谢物与ALS风险之间的潜在因果关联，并探索脑容量的中介作用。研究利用公开的全基因组关联研究汇总统计数据进行了一项两样本孟德尔随机化（MR）研究。血浆代谢物的遗传工具来自代谢组学GWAS数据集，ALS相关遗传数据作为结局。逆方差加权法作为主要分析方法，并使用MR-Egger回归、加权中位数分析、MR-PRESSO、异质性检验和留一法分析进行敏感性分析。进一步进行两步MR分析，以评估脑容量是否介导了代谢物与ALS之间的关联。六种代谢物与ALS风险存在显著关联。遗传预测的较高水平N,N-二甲基丙氨酸、山嵛酰肉碱（C22）和脱氧肉碱与ALS风险增加相关，而较高水平的(N(1) + N(8))-乙酰精胺、甜菜碱和十四碳二烯二酸（C14:2-DC）与ALS风险降低相关。敏感性分析支持这些发现的稳健性。两步MR分析提示，脑容量并未显著介导这些代谢物与ALS风险之间的关联。本研究确定了6种与ALS风险存在遗传关联的循环代谢物。这些发现为ALS可能涉及的代谢通路提供了见解，并提示所观察到的关联不太可能通过脑容量变化介导。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究采用两步孟德尔随机化方法，新近识别出6种与ALS风险存在遗传因果关联的循环代谢物，为ALS代谢机制和潜在生物标志物转化提供了新线索。

items.title: Cellular senescence is an early feature and therapeutic target in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis TDP-43 Q331K mice.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder characterized by progressive motor neuron degeneration in the motor cortex and spinal cord. Aging is a key risk factor for ALS, and cellular senescence - a hallmark of aging marked by irreversible cell-cycle arrest and a pro-inflammatory senescence-associated secretory phenotype - has been implicated in neurodegeneration, yet its role in ALS progression remains incompletely understood. Here, we show that molecular markers of cellular senescence emerge in the motor cortex and spinal cord alongside declines in neural and neuromuscular function in TDP-43 Q331K ALS mice, supporting senescence as an early feature of ALS pathology. To test whether reduced senescence ameliorates ALS pathology, we evaluated longitudinal senolytic treatment with dasatinib and quercetin (D&Q) in TDP-43 Q331K mice. D&Q treatment improved motor behavior, neuromuscular function, and reduced axonal damage as measured by plasma neurofilament light chain, accompanied by robust improvements in motor cortex excitability and preservation of layer V neuron counts. At the cellular level, cortical microglia were implicated as a potential mediator of senolytic benefits based on reduced microglial TDP-43 burden and senescence markers. Together, these findings identify cellular senescence as an early, disease-relevant, and modifiable feature of ALS pathology.
items.titleZh: 细胞衰老是肌萎缩侧索硬化TDP-43 Q331K小鼠的早期特征及治疗靶点
items.summaryZh: 该研究在TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠模型中发现，细胞衰老标志物在运动皮层和脊髓中早期出现，并与神经及神经肌肉功能下降同步。使用达沙替尼联合槲皮素进行衰老细胞清除治疗，可改善运动行为、神经肌肉功能和运动皮层兴奋性，减少轴突损伤，并保留皮层V层神经元。皮层小胶质细胞可能是介导这些获益的关键细胞类型。研究提示细胞衰老是ALS早期、可干预的病理特征。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，以运动皮层和脊髓中运动神经元的进行性退变为特征。衰老是ALS的关键危险因素，而细胞衰老——一种以不可逆细胞周期停滞和促炎性衰老相关分泌表型为标志的衰老特征——已被认为与神经退行性变有关，但其在ALS进展中的作用仍不完全清楚。在此，我们显示，在TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠中，细胞衰老的分子标志物与神经及神经肌肉功能下降同时出现在运动皮层和脊髓中，支持衰老是ALS病理的早期特征。为检验减少衰老是否能改善ALS病理，我们在TDP-43 Q331K小鼠中评估了达沙替尼和槲皮素（D&Q）的纵向衰老细胞清除治疗。D&Q治疗改善了运动行为、神经肌肉功能，并减少了通过血浆神经丝轻链测得的轴突损伤，同时伴有运动皮层兴奋性的显著改善和V层神经元计数的保留。在细胞水平上，基于小胶质细胞TDP-43负荷和衰老标志物的减少，皮层小胶质细胞被认为是衰老细胞清除获益的潜在介导者。总之，这些发现将细胞衰老确定为ALS病理的一个早期、疾病相关且可修饰的特征。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，首次在TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠中证明细胞衰老是早期可修饰特征，并显示临床在研的衰老细胞清除药物D&Q可改善功能与病理，具有明确的ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: What do ALS motor phenotypes measure? A population-based decomposition of their prognostic dimensions.
items.summary: The ALS-OPM 3.3 classification stratifies incident ALS through three axes: onset region (O), propagation time (P) and motor-neuron pattern (M). We assessed whether OPM 3.3 improves prognostic discrimination over established classifications and characterised how it decomposes their prognostic signal in a population-based cohort. In the prospective Piedmont and Aosta Valley ALS Register (2000-2022), patients were classified on the three axes; M was operationalised as M_3class (M0 balanced, M1d UMN-predominant, M2d LMN-predominant), with the PLS-spectrum M1p analysed separately. Outcome was survival (death or tracheostomy) from onset. Multivariable Cox models (O, P1(n), M_3class, age, sex) underwent bootstrap optimism-correction and fivefold cross-validation, and were compared against alternative taxonomies and clinical staging systems. Amongst 2,738 non-PLS patients (2,561 events, 93.5%), median survival differed across M classes (M0 27.0, M2d 36.0, M1d 41.9 months). OPM 3.3 outperformed the bulbar/spinal dichotomy but matched the classical phenotype (optimism-corrected C-index 0.703, 95% CI 0.685-0.719 vs 0.701). In the arm-proximal cell (95.7% M2d), the O2p protective effect vanished after M adjustment (HR 0.99, 95% CI 0.79-1.24), whilst M2d retained HR 0.83 (95% CI 0.72-0.95), showing prognosis reflects motor-neuron pattern, not anatomy. Adding King's, Milano-Torino (MiToS), or Fine'til 9 (FT9) clinical staging further improved discrimination. OPM 3.3 did not improve discrimination over established phenotypes but decomposed their prognostic signal into independently interpretable dimensions. Favourable prognosis of arm-proximal/flail-arm onset reflects the underlying LMN-predominant phenotype, not onset site. The motor-neuron axis is robust to the treatment of the propagation axis and independent of clinical staging.
items.titleZh: ALS运动表型测量的是什么？基于人群的预后维度分解研究
items.summaryZh: 这项基于人群的观察性研究分析了2,738例ALS患者，发现ALS-OPM 3.3分类中的运动神经元模式（M轴）是独立的预后因素：下运动神经元为主型（M2d）生存期长于均衡型（M0），而上运动神经元为主型（M1d）生存期最长。臂近端起病（连枷臂）的预后优势实际上源于其下运动神经元为主的表型，而非起病部位本身。OPM 3.3整体区分能力与经典表型相当，但能分解预后信号；联合临床分期可进一步提高区分度。
items.insight: 该研究通过大规模人群队列和严格的统计校正，厘清了ALS表型与预后的关系：运动神经元模式（上/下运动神经元受累）是比起病解剖部位更本质的预后维度。这提示在临床试验分层、预后模型构建及治疗靶点选择中，应优先考虑运动神经元病理生理轴，而非单纯依据起病部位。同时，OPM 3.3与临床分期系统互补，为未来多维度预后评估提供了框架。

aiRead.keyFinding: ALS-OPM 3.3分类中的运动神经元模式（M轴）独立于起病部位和临床分期预测生存；臂近端起病的预后优势由下运动神经元为主表型驱动，而非解剖位置。
aiRead.limitation: 研究为观察性设计，未涉及治疗干预；OPM 3.3未比经典表型提高区分能力；结果基于特定人群（意大利皮埃蒙特和奥斯塔谷），外推需谨慎。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续可关注OPM 3.3与生物标志物（如神经丝轻链）或遗传亚型的整合，以及在前瞻性临床试验中验证运动神经元模式作为分层因素的价值。

items.abstractZh: ALS-OPM 3.3分类通过三个轴对初发ALS进行分层：起病区域（O）、进展时间（P）和运动神经元模式（M）。我们在一个基于人群的队列中评估了OPM 3.3是否比现有分类提高了预后区分能力，并刻画了它如何分解这些分类的预后信号。在前瞻性皮埃蒙特和奥斯塔谷ALS登记研究（2000-2022年）中，患者按三个轴进行分类；M被操作为M_3class（M0均衡型、M1d上运动神经元为主型、M2d下运动神经元为主型），PLS谱系的M1p单独分析。结局为从起病开始的生存（死亡或气管切开）。多变量Cox模型（O、P1(n)、M_3class、年龄、性别）经过bootstrap乐观校正和五折交叉验证，并与替代分类法和临床分期系统进行比较。在2,738例非PLS患者中（2,561例事件，93.5%），中位生存期在不同M类之间存在差异（M0为27.0个月，M2d为36.0个月，M1d为41.9个月）。OPM 3.3优于延髓/脊髓二分法，但与经典表型相当（乐观校正C指数0.703，95% CI 0.685-0.719 vs 0.701）。在臂近端细胞中（95.7%为M2d），O2p的保护效应在M调整后消失（HR 0.99，95% CI 0.79-1.24），而M2d保持HR 0.83（95% CI 0.72-0.95），表明预后反映的是运动神经元模式，而非解剖位置。加入King's、Milano-Torino（MiToS）或Fine'til 9（FT9）临床分期后，区分能力进一步提高。OPM 3.3并未比现有表型提高区分能力，但将其预后信号分解为可独立解释的维度。臂近端/连枷臂起病的不良预后良好反映的是潜在的下运动神经元为主表型，而非起病部位。运动神经元轴对进展轴的处理方式稳健，且独立于临床分期。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2000-2022年前瞻性人群登记数据，新近证实运动神经元模式是ALS预后的独立维度，对临床试验分层和预后标志物开发具有直接转化价值。

items.title: Thioperamide, a histamine H3 receptor antagonist, attenuates neuroimmune activation and inflammation in the SOD1 G93A mouse model of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a neurodegenerative disorder of unknown cause that gradually affects upper and lower motor neurons in the motor cortex, brainstem, and spinal cord. The histamine H3 receptor (H3R), a presynaptic autoreceptor, regulates histamine release through feedback mechanisms. H3R is highly expressed in neurons and microglia, where it influences inflammatory responses. This study examined the effects of thioperamide, an H3R antagonist, on T cell-mediated immune responses in the SOD1G93A transgenic mouse model of ALS. Mice received daily thioperamide injections (5 mg/kg) for four weeks, beginning at the onset of illness (week 15). Flow cytometry analyzed splenic CD3 + T cells for cytokine and marker expression, including IL-1α, IL-6, IFN-γ, TNF-α, IL-17A, RORγt, iNOS, GM-CSF, TGF-β1, and Foxp3. RT-PCR measured mRNA levels in brain tissue. Results showed that thioperamide significantly decreased CD3 + IL-1α + , CD3 + IL-6 + , CD3 + IFN-γ + , CD3 + TNF-α + , CD3 + IL-17A + , CD3 + RORγt + , CD3 + iNOS + , and CD3 + GM-CSF + cells in the spleen, while increasing regulatory CD3 + TGF-β1 + and CD3 + Foxp3 + cells. Similarly, brain tissue showed decreased mRNA levels of IL-1α, IL-6, IFN-γ, TNF-α, IL-17A, RORγt, iNOS, and GM-CSF, with higher TGF-β1 and Foxp3 expression. These findings suggest that thioperamide helps reestablish immune balance in SOD1 G93A mice by influencing both inflammatory and regulatory T cell pathways.
items.titleZh: 组胺H3受体拮抗剂硫丙拉明可减轻肌萎缩侧索硬化SOD1 G93A小鼠模型中的神经免疫激活和炎症
items.summaryZh: 该研究在SOD1 G93A ALS小鼠模型中，从发病期开始给予组胺H3受体拮抗剂硫丙拉明四周，观察到脾脏促炎性T细胞亚群减少、调节性T细胞增加，脑组织促炎因子mRNA下降、调节性标志物升高。结果提示靶向H3R可能调节ALS相关神经免疫失衡，但尚属动物实验阶段，不能推断临床疗效。
items.insight: 该研究将组胺H3受体这一神经免疫调节靶点与ALS中T细胞介导的炎症失衡联系起来，并在发病期干预模型中展示了促炎/调节性T细胞通路的双向调节。对于关注神经炎症机制和免疫调节策略的ALS研究者，这提供了一个可进一步验证的候选靶点，后续需关注其在其他ALS模型、性别差异、疾病阶段依赖性以及运动神经元存活和生存期等终点上的效果。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种病因不明的神经退行性疾病，逐渐累及运动皮层、脑干和脊髓的上、下运动神经元。组胺H3受体（H3R）是一种突触前自身受体，通过反馈机制调节组胺释放。H3R在神经元和小胶质细胞中高表达，并影响炎症反应。本研究在ALS的SOD1G93A转基因小鼠模型中检测了H3R拮抗剂硫丙拉明对T细胞介导免疫应答的影响。小鼠自发病起始（第15周）起每日注射硫丙拉明（5 mg/kg），持续四周。采用流式细胞术分析脾脏CD3+ T细胞的细胞因子和标志物表达，包括IL-1α、IL-6、IFN-γ、TNF-α、IL-17A、RORγt、iNOS、GM-CSF、TGF-β1和Foxp3。采用RT-PCR测定脑组织中的mRNA水平。结果显示，硫丙拉明显著减少脾脏中CD3+ IL-1α+、CD3+ IL-6+、CD3+ IFN-γ+、CD3+ TNF-α+、CD3+ IL-17A+、CD3+ RORγt+、CD3+ iNOS+和CD3+ GM-CSF+细胞，同时增加调节性CD3+ TGF-β1+和CD3+ Foxp3+细胞。类似地，脑组织中IL-1α、IL-6、IFN-γ、TNF-α、IL-17A、RORγt、iNOS和GM-CSF的mRNA水平降低，而TGF-β1和Foxp3表达升高。这些发现提示，硫丙拉明通过影响炎症性和调节性T细胞通路，有助于在SOD1 G93A小鼠中重建免疫平衡。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近在SOD1 G93A ALS小鼠中证明组胺H3受体拮抗可重塑T细胞免疫平衡，为ALS神经免疫调节提供了具有转化潜力的新靶点。

items.title: Management of choking in Motor Neuron Disease: patient and public involvement in a co-produced mixed-methods study protocol.
items.summary: Up to 70% of people living with Motor Neuron Disease (plwMND) report distressing episodes of choking (a feeling of suffocation or airways blockage) due to involvement of bulbar muscles. There is an evidence gap on management of choking in plwMND, which is mirrored by the absence of guidance and training for healthcare professionals. Choking in plwMND is associated with other signs of bulbar involvement, such as communication difficulties due to dysarthria, which can be a barrier to effective participation in research. In this study protocol, we describe an innovative approach to meaningful involvement of plwMND, to co-produce a research project on management of choking tailored to their needs and aligning with their priorities. Phase 1 (Patient and public involvement co-design meeting): We first engaged in a meeting with plwMND, carers and healthcare professionals, to identify their priorities in relation to improving management of choking in MND. To ensure inclusive participation, we used the Theory of Change framework; people with communication difficulties were supported by a Speech and Language Therapist through their chosen augmentative and alternative communication aids. A key priority identified was the need to produce evidence-based guidance for management of choking tailored to the needs of plwMND. Phase 2 (Healthcare research study protocol on management of choking): based on the outcome of Phase 1, a multidisciplinary team (including individuals with lived experience) designed a mixed-methods, multi-centre research project based on four work packages (WPs). WP1: systematic review of the existing scientific literature on management of choking; WP2: interviews and focus groups with people with lived experience of choking in MND; WP3: co-design of a clinical algorithm detailing interventions to manage choking, based on WP1 and 2; WP4: algorithm development and dissemination with continuous involvement and input from people with lived experience through a Patient and Public Involvement co-applicant and patients' representatives. In plwMND and choking, barriers to inclusion in PPI and research range from reduced accessibility due to physical disabilities, to discriminatory sampling due to communication issues. Through inclusive engagement at the outset, plwMND highlighted a mismatch between their priorities (gaining knowledge about choking and feeling empowered to manage it at home) and available evidence (lack of guidance and training for healthcare professionals). This research project aligns with what matters to most affected patients, their carers and healthcare professionals, aiming to fill an evidence gap through new guidance to manage choking tailored to their needs. Motor Neuron Disease (MND) is a life-limiting condition that damages nerve cells in the brain and spinal cord. It gets worse over time and cannot be cured. As the disease progresses, muscles become weaker, including those used for breathing, swallowing, coughing and speaking. People with MND often have trouble keeping their airways clear. Food, drinks or saliva can go down the wrong way and block the airway. This can cause choking. In people with MND, choking can happen more often, be more severe, and last longer than in other people. It can also happen outside of mealtimes. Choking is frightening for both patients and carers. It can lead to emergency calls, hospital visits and urgent medical treatment. Knowing what to do during a choking episode is important for patients, carers and healthcare professionals. However, there is currently no specific guidance or training designed for people with MND and those who care for them. Communication can also become difficult for people with MND, which can make it harder for them to take part in research and have their voice heard. In this project, people with lived experience of MND and episodes of choking have worked together to identify new research outcomes and set the path for next stages of research in this field. Together we will: (1) review and summarise the best available evidence on how to manage choking in MND, and identify gaps in knowledge; (2) talk to people with MND, their carers and healthcare professionals, to understand their experiences and needs; (3) use this information to develop practical guidance on how to manage choking; (4) share this guidance with the MND community and healthcare professionals.

items.titleZh: 运动神经元病中窒息的管理：患者与公众参与共同制定的混合方法研究方案
items.summaryZh: 这是一项研究方案，旨在通过患者与公众参与共同制定关于运动神经元病（MND）窒息管理的混合方法研究。方案分两阶段：第一阶段通过共同设计会议确定患者优先事项，发现需要基于证据的窒息管理指南；第二阶段设计包含四个工作包的多中心研究，包括系统综述、访谈与焦点小组、共同设计临床算法以及算法开发与传播。研究强调包容性参与，支持有沟通困难的患者使用辅助沟通设备。该方案目前不报告任何疗效结果，而是描述研究设计和患者参与方法。
items.insight: 该方案值得ALS研究者跟踪，因为它聚焦于MND中常见但证据不足的窒息管理问题，并采用患者与公众参与共同设计的方法，可能产生更贴合患者需求的临床算法和指南。其多学科、混合方法设计及对沟通障碍患者的包容性参与策略，为未来开展以患者为中心的ALS症状管理研究提供了可借鉴的框架。

items.abstractZh: 高达70%的运动神经元病（MND）患者报告因延髓肌受累而出现令人痛苦的窒息发作（一种窒息感或气道阻塞感）。关于MND患者窒息管理存在证据空白，这反映在医疗专业人员缺乏相关指南和培训上。MND中的窒息与延髓受累的其他体征相关，例如因构音障碍导致的沟通困难，这可能成为有效参与研究的障碍。在本研究方案中，我们描述了一种创新方法，旨在让MND患者有意义地参与，共同制定一项针对其需求并与其优先事项相一致的有关窒息管理的研究项目。第一阶段（患者与公众参与共同设计会议）：我们首先与MND患者、照护者和医疗专业人员举行会议，以确定他们在改善MND窒息管理方面的优先事项。为确保包容性参与，我们使用了变革理论框架；有沟通困难的人士由言语治疗师通过其选择的辅助和替代沟通设备提供支持。确定的一个关键优先事项是需要制定针对MND患者需求量身定制的、基于证据的窒息管理指南。第二阶段（关于窒息管理的医疗研究方案）：基于第一阶段的结果，一个多学科团队（包括有亲身经历的人士）设计了一个混合方法、多中心研究项目，基于四个工作包（WP）。WP1：对现有关于窒息管理的科学文献进行系统综述；WP2：对MND窒息有亲身经历的人士进行访谈和焦点小组；WP3：基于WP1和WP2共同设计一个详细说明窒息管理干预措施的临床算法；WP4：算法的开发和传播，并通过患者与公众参与共同申请人和患者代表持续获得有亲身经历人士的参与和投入。在MND患者和窒息方面，参与PPI和研究的障碍包括因身体残疾导致的可及性降低，以及因沟通问题导致的歧视性抽样。通过从一开始就进行包容性参与，MND患者强调了他们的优先事项（获取关于窒息的知识并感到有能力在家中管理它）与现有证据（医疗专业人员缺乏指南和培训）之间的不匹配。本研究项目与大多数受影响患者、其照护者和医疗专业人员所关心的事项相一致，旨在通过新的、针对其需求量身定制的窒息管理指南来填补证据空白。运动神经元病（MND）是一种限制生命的疾病，会损害大脑和脊髓中的神经细胞。它会随时间恶化且无法治愈。随着疾病进展，肌肉变得无力，包括用于呼吸、吞咽、咳嗽和说话的肌肉。MND患者常常难以保持气道通畅。食物、饮料或唾液可能进入错误通道并阻塞气道。这可能导致窒息。在MND患者中，窒息可能比其他人群发生更频繁、更严重且持续时间更长。它也可能在非进餐时间发生。窒息对患者和照护者来说都是可怕的。它可能导致紧急呼叫、住院和紧急医疗处理。了解窒息发作时该怎么做对患者、照护者和医疗专业人员都很重要。然而，目前没有专门为MND患者及其照护者设计的特定指南或培训。MND患者的沟通也可能变得困难，这可能使他们更难参与研究并让他们的声音被听到。在这个项目中，有MND和窒息发作亲身经历的人士共同合作，确定了新的研究结局，并为该领域下一阶段研究指明了方向。我们将共同：（1）回顾和总结关于如何管理MND中窒息的最佳现有证据，并确定知识空白；（2）与MND患者、其照护者和医疗专业人员交谈，了解他们的经历和需求；（3）利用这些信息制定关于如何管理窒息的实用指南；（4）与MND社区和医疗专业人员分享该指南。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究方案针对MND窒息管理这一证据空白，采用患者与公众参与共同设计的新近方法，具有明确的转化价值，有望为临床实践提供基于证据的指导。

items.title: Associations of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) exposures and firefighting experience with microRNA signatures previously linked to Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS): a cross-sectional analysis of active-duty municipal and airport firefighters.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder with unclear etiology in sporadic cases. Blood microRNA (miRNA) expression varies between individuals with and without ALS. Firefighters may face elevated ALS risks due to occupational exposures, including elevated serum per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) concentrations. This study investigates the association between occupational firefighter characteristics (years of experience, incumbent status (binary; 1=incumbent, 0=recruit), serum PFAS) and ALS-relevant miRNA expression in U.S. firefighters across 10 states. MiRNA expression was quantified from blood collected from 608 firefighters. Serum PFAS concentrations were available for a subset of 302 participants. We identified 19 ALS-related miRNAs using miRWalk's Disease Ontology. Adjusted linear regression models estimated associations between exposures and miRNA expression, controlling for demographic and occupational factors. In analyses of firefighter occupational characteristics (n=608), incumbent firefighters had significantly altered expression in ten ALS-related miRNAs compared to new recruits (p<0.05) and all remained significant after false discovery rate (FDR) adjustment for multiple testing (q<0.20). Years of firefighting was associated with lower expression of multiple miRNAs, including hsa-miR-23a-3p (β = -11.276, 95% CI: -18.870, -3.682), and this association remained significant after FDR correction. In PFAS analyses (n=302), higher serum PFAS concentrations were associated with 13 significant PFAS-miRNA associations (p<0.05) involving ALS-related miRNAs, including Sm-PFOS and hsa-let-7i-5p (β = -0.169, 95% CI: -0.287, -0.052), hsa-let-7c-5p (β = -0.128, 95% CI: -0.218, -0.037), and hsa-let-7e-5p (β = -0.113, 95% CI: -0.210, -0.017); PFNA and hsa-let-7c-5p (β = -0.126, 95% CI: -0.214, -0.037); and PFHxS and hsa-let-7i-5p (β = -0.126, 95% CI: -0.223, -0.029). Six remained significant after FDR adjustment (q < 0.20). Hsa-let-7e-5p was significantly lower in firefighters with higher Sm-PFOS, n-PFOS, and in incumbent firefighters. Significant associations between PFAS exposure, firefighting status, and ALS-related miRNAs suggest that PFAS exposure and firefighting characteristics are associated with miRNA expression patterns previously linked to ALS, warranting further investigation into potential biological pathways.

items.titleZh: 全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）暴露及消防员经历与既往与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）相关的微小RNA特征之间的关联：一项针对现役市政和机场消防员的横断面分析
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究在美国10个州的608名消防员中，分析了消防职业特征（从业年限、在职状态）和血清PFAS浓度与19个既往与ALS相关的血液miRNA表达之间的关联。结果显示，在职消防员相比新兵有10个ALS相关miRNA表达显著改变；从业年限越长，部分miRNA表达越低；较高的血清PFAS（如Sm-PFOS、PFNA、PFHxS）与多个let-7家族等ALS相关miRNA表达降低相关。研究提示职业暴露可能通过影响ALS相关miRNA表达模式而与ALS风险产生联系，但作为横断面设计，不能推断因果或临床疗效。
items.insight: 该研究将消防员这一ALS高风险职业人群与PFAS暴露、ALS相关miRNA特征三者联系起来，为环境/职业暴露通过表观遗传调控通路影响ALS风险提供了可检验的假说。对ALS研究者而言，其价值在于提示特定miRNA（尤其是let-7家族和miR-23a-3p）可作为暴露相关早期生物标志物候选，并值得在纵向队列和机制实验中验证其与神经退行性变的因果关系。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，散发病例的病因尚不明确。血液微小RNA（miRNA）表达在ALS患者与非ALS个体之间存在差异。消防员可能因职业暴露（包括血清全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）浓度升高）而面临更高的ALS风险。本研究调查了美国10个州消防员的职业消防特征（从业年限、在职状态（二分类；1=在职，0=新兵）、血清PFAS）与ALS相关miRNA表达之间的关联。从608名消防员采集的血液中定量了miRNA表达。其中302名参与者有血清PFAS浓度数据。我们利用miRWalk的疾病本体（Disease Ontology）识别出19个ALS相关miRNA。采用校正线性回归模型估计暴露与miRNA表达之间的关联，并控制人口学和职业因素。在消防员职业特征分析中（n=608），与新人职消防员相比，在职消防员的10个ALS相关miRNA表达发生显著改变（p<0.05），且经错误发现率（FDR）多重检验校正后仍全部显著（q<0.20）。消防从业年限与多个miRNA表达降低相关，包括hsa-miR-23a-3p（β = -11.276，95% CI：-18.870，-3.682），该关联经FDR校正后仍显著。在PFAS分析中（n=302），较高的血清PFAS浓度与13个涉及ALS相关miRNA的显著PFAS-miRNA关联相关（p<0.05），包括Sm-PFOS与hsa-let-7i-5p（β = -0.169，95% CI：-0.287，-0.052）、hsa-let-7c-5p（β = -0.128，95% CI：-0.218，-0.037）和hsa-let-7e-5p（β = -0.113，95% CI：-0.210，-0.017）；PFNA与hsa-let-7c-5p（β = -0.126，95% CI：-0.214，-0.037）；以及PFHxS与hsa-let-7i-5p（β = -0.126，95% CI：-0.223，-0.029）。其中6个关联经FDR校正后仍显著（q<0.20）。在Sm-PFOS、n-PFOS较高以及在职消防员中，hsa-let-7e-5p显著降低。PFAS暴露、消防员状态与ALS相关miRNA之间的显著关联提示，PFAS暴露和消防特征与既往与ALS相关的miRNA表达模式有关，值得进一步研究其潜在生物学通路。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近将职业性PFAS暴露与既往与ALS相关的循环miRNA特征关联起来，为ALS环境风险因素的表观遗传机制和生物标志物转化提供了值得跟踪的线索。

items.title: Serum Na-Cl value from routine blood tests reflects CO2 retention in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Respiratory failure is the leading cause of death in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Early detection of CO2 retention is crucial for assessing respiratory failure severity and guiding noninvasive positive pressure ventilation (NPPV) management. However, arterial blood gas analysis is invasive and uncomfortable for routine monitoring. We investigated whether the serum sodium-chloride difference (Na-Cl value), calculated from routine blood tests, could serve as a screening marker for CO2 retention in ALS patients. This retrospective study included 88 ALS patients with 116 paired samples of arterial blood gas and serum electrolyte data. We analyzed correlations between Na-Cl value and blood gas parameters (HCO3-, PCO2), performed receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis for detecting CO2 retention (PCO2 ≥ 45 mmHg), and examined relationships with respiratory function (%FVC). Na-Cl value showed strong correlation with HCO3- (r = 0.78, p < 0.001) and PCO2 (r = 0.71, p < 0.001). Na-Cl ≥ 37 mEq/L demonstrated sensitivity of 85.11% and specificity of 69.57% for detecting PCO2 ≥ 45 mmHg, with negative predictive value of 87.27% (AUC = 0.842). Na-Cl ≥ 39 mEq/L achieved specificity of 92.75%. Patients with %FVC < 50% had significantly higher Na-Cl, PCO2, and HCO3- values. Serum Na-Cl value serves as a simple, noninvasive screening marker for CO2 retention in ALS. Na-Cl ≥ 37 mEq/L warrants blood gas analysis, while Na-Cl ≥ 39 mEq/L provides specificity >90%. This marker can be calculated from routine blood tests without additional cost, making it suitable for frequent monitoring and reducing the risk of missing intervention timing.

items.title: Metabolic alterations in the absence of a neuromuscular phenotype in humanized SOD1 A5V mice.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis caused by mutations in superoxide dismutase 1 ( SOD1 ) accounts for 15-30% of familial cases and is typically autosomal dominant. How single amino acid changes in this small protein cause neurodegeneration is unknown. In North America, SOD1 A5V is the most common familial SOD1 mutation and results in an aggressive form of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Here, we present a novel genomically humanized mouse model of SOD1 A5V , in which the mouse Sod1 locus has been replaced by the human SOD1 gene, with intact genomic architecture of exons and introns, but bearing an A5 V mutation. In agreement with previously reported human genomic knock-in mice, the phenotype is mild; however, transcriptomic and metabolomic profiling reveal significant dysregulation of glycolysis, the tricarboxylic acid cycle, and lipid metabolism. These changes suggest an early bioenergetic imbalance that precedes neuromuscular impairment. Our findings support metabolic dysfunction as an early event in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis pathogenesis. This freely available SOD1 A5V model provides a valuable tool for studying amyotrophic lateral sclerosis progression and identifying therapeutic targets for pre-symptomatic treatment.
